screens.name: Html → Body → Main - Mobile Screen Container
texts:
Muslims pray five times a day
to stay connected with Allah

The five daily prayers (Salah) are Fajr
(dawn), Dhuhr (midday), Asr (afternoon),
Maghrib (sunset), and Isha (night). Each
prayer is a time to pause, remember Allah,
and ask for His guidance.

prayer is like a river we bathe in five times a
day—it washes away our mistakes and
keeps us spiritually clean. By praying
regularly, we build a strong relationship
with Allah and stay mindful of our actions
throughout the day.

This fact has been reviewed and approved by
qualified Islamic scholars to ensure accuracy and
appropriateness for children. The review date and
version help us maintain up-to-date content.

The exact timing of prayers may vary
slightly between different schools of
Islamic thought (madhabs).
